title: Guided inspection
description: A library plan moves beneath a precisely aligned spotlight as a three-stop walkthrough explores its rooms.
useCase: Guide inspection of a diagram, product or technical illustration through one shared camera transform.
interaction: Start the walkthrough; advance through three points or use arrow keys. Escape exits.
reducedMotion: Camera and spotlight update immediately; the three steps remain available.
limitations: A local SVG floor plan, not a DOM element targeting or page-onboarding service.
look: Pale sage floor plan with dark green walls, muted green furniture and round trees, orange numbered hotspots, and a dark green button below.
motion: Each step pans and zooms the plan to a room while a dimming mask's cut-out follows, both over 550 ms ease-out; keyboard steps apply instantly, Escape exits.
adapt: The camera is the `gi-camera` group transform and the spotlight the `gi-focus` mask rect, both transitioned with `.55s cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.22,1)`; `tx`, `ty` and `s` centre the stop. Replace the SVG plan and `STOPS` bounds, scales and notes.
